qualifier: defective lipid-linked oligosaccharide glycosyltransferases (ALG, DPAGT1)
name: Congenital glycosylation disorders of lipid-linked oligosaccharide glycosyltransferases
rationale: All members are CDGs caused by the ALG/DPAGT1 glycosyltransferases that build the dolichol-linked oligosaccharide, whereas confusables centre on precursor (mannose, dolichol, DPM) supply, flippase or Golgi defects.

qualifier: with hypusine, diphthamide and hydroxylation residue modifications
name: Polyamine metabolism and hypusine-diphthamide-type protein residue modification
rationale: Members combine putrescine/spermidine/spermine synthesis, interconversion and transport with specialised residue modifications of translation factors and tRNA (hypusine, diphthamide, hydroxylation, wybutosine); confusables carry only the modification half or only the amine half.

qualifier: cytosolic and mitochondrial, for translational fidelity
name: tRNA maturation, modification and aminoacylation for translational fidelity
rationale: Members cover tRNA end processing, splicing, base modification and aminoacylation in nucleus, cytosol and mitochondria plus fidelity-related RNA modification, while confusables centre on rRNA modification or mitochondrial ribosome and translation machinery.

qualifier: nephron progenitor proliferation, survival and maintenance
name: Kidney growth control via nephron progenitor proliferation and survival
rationale: Members regulate kidney/metanephros size through mesenchymal progenitor proliferation, apoptosis and stem-cell maintenance, whereas confusables concern duct, tubule and nephron differentiation and morphogenesis.

qualifier: nutrient, amino acid and energy sensing
name: Nutrient- and energy-sensing mTOR signalling
rationale: Members describe TORC1/TORC2 regulation by amino acids, glucose starvation, LKB1-AMPK and AKT-TSC with downstream translation control, while confusables centre on PTEN and PI3K/ERBB restraint.

qualifier: including microautophagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy
name: Selective autophagy, microautophagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy
rationale: Members cover cargo-selective autophagy (pexophagy, mitophagy, aggrephagy, nucleophagy), phagophore cargo targeting and the CMA/microautophagy routes that confusables lack, as they focus on mitochondrial dynamics, reticulophagy or proteostasis.

qualifier: ornithine transcarbamylase deficiency
name: Urea cycle citrulline-arginine synthesis and ornithine transcarbamylase deficiency
rationale: Members span urea-cycle citrulline and arginine biosynthesis and OTC variant deficiencies, distinguishing them from confusables on ornithine transport/catabolism or other urea-cycle enzyme deficiencies.

qualifier: IL-12/IL-23 and IL-10
name: IL-12/IL-23 and IL-10 immunoregulatory cytokine signalling
rationale: All members are IL-12, IL-23 or IL-10 signalling pathways, whereas confusables involve IL-15/21, IL-27/35/37 or IL-17/33/36 signalling.

core: Dendrite and postsynaptic actin cytoskeleton organisation
qualifier: filopodium and cell-shape control
name: Actin cytoskeletal shaping of dendrites, spines and filopodia
rationale: Members regulate dendrite arborization, spine and postsynaptic actin structure and filopodium assembly via Rho/EphB signalling, while confusables emphasise synaptic plasticity, NMDAR-RAC1, reelin or BDNF signalling.

qualifier: with hyaluronan degradation
name: Scavenger receptor-mediated clearance and hyaluronan degradation
rationale: Members are class A/B/F/H scavenger receptor pathways plus hyaluronan catabolism and its regulation (class H stabilins clear hyaluronan), which confusables on lipoprotein or apoptotic-cell clearance lack.

qualifier: gasdermin pore execution
name: Gasdermin pore-mediated pyroptotic cell death
rationale: All members describe pyroptosis execution and its defects, distinct from confusables on inflammasome assembly and IL-1 processing upstream.

qualifier: activated CD4 T cells
name: Proliferative cell-cycle program of activated CD4 T cells
rationale: All members are modules of mitosis and cell division in stimulated CD4 T cells, whereas confusables are generic E2F, G2/M or DNA replication programs.

qualifier: spermatogenesis, germ-cell specification and zygotic genome activation
name: Germline specification, spermatogenesis and early zygotic genome activation
rationale: Members span primordial germ cell specification, germline stem cells, spermatogenesis and sperm chromatin remodelling, piRNA control and ZGA, while confusables centre on heterochromatin, imprinting, oocyte and maternal-to-zygotic transition.

qualifier: responses to addictive drugs including nicotine and ethanol
name: Dopaminergic reward signalling and responses to addictive drugs
rationale: Members combine dopamine/opioid receptor signalling and nicotinic receptors with behavioural and cellular responses to cocaine, amphetamine, nicotine and ethanol, which confusables on neuropeptide behaviour or catecholamine transport lack.

qualifier: motile cilia, sperm flagella and photoreceptor outer segments
name: Ciliogenesis, ciliary trafficking and motility including sperm flagella
rationale: Members cover basal body/centriole formation, intraflagellar and cargo trafficking, motile cilia and sperm flagellum assembly and their tissue roles, while confusables concern mitotic centrosomes, retinal development, kinesins or tubulin modification.

qualifier: keratinocyte, adhesion and matrix disassembly
name: Regulation of epithelial and keratinocyte cell migration
rationale: Members regulate epithelial and keratinocyte migration (with EGF response and focal adhesion/ECM disassembly), whereas confusables emphasise keratinocyte proliferation, wound inflammation or negative adhesion signalling.

core: G protein-coupled control of adenylate cyclase
qualifier: inhibitory Gi/Gz and alpha-2 adrenergic
name: Inhibitory G-protein and alpha-2 adrenergic control of adenylate cyclase
rationale: Members describe GPCR coupling to cyclic nucleotide production, especially Gi/Gz and alpha-2 adrenergic inhibition of adenylate cyclase, distinct from confusables on adrenoceptor-catecholamine secretion or muscarinic signalling.

qualifier: stomach development, acid secretion and motility
name: Stomach development, gastric secretion and gastrointestinal motility
rationale: Members concern stomach development, gastric acid secretion and GI smooth muscle motility, whereas confusables cover generic or urogenital smooth muscle, enteric nervous development or serotonin receptors.

qualifier: centromeric cohesion and its resolution
name: Centromeric sister chromatid cohesion and its resolution
rationale: Members all concern establishing and resolving (centromeric) sister chromatid cohesion leading to separation, while confusables cover spindle checkpoint, spindle assembly or APC/C regulation.

qualifier: flipping/scrambling and ER tubular network shaping
name: Phospholipid transfer, flipping and ER tubular network shaping
rationale: Members cover intermembrane phospholipid transfer, flippase/scramblase translocation and ER tubule formation, fusion and tethering, which confusables on glycolipid transport, Golgi traffic, mitochondria-ER contacts or phosphoinositides lack.

qualifier: error-prone translesion and long-patch base excision repair
name: Error-prone translesion synthesis and base excision repair gap filling
rationale: Members are POLK/POLI/REV1 translesion synthesis and polymerase-dependent BER gap filling and flap removal, distinct from confusables on NER, replication, glycosylase/mismatch repair or telomere synthesis.

qualifier: proliferation, fusion and skeletal muscle regeneration
name: Myoblast differentiation, fusion and skeletal muscle regeneration
rationale: Members regulate myoblast commitment, proliferation, differentiation and fusion and regenerative muscle growth, while confusables concern satellite-cell maintenance, fibre homeostasis or atrophy.

qualifier: tetrahydrobiopterin, vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactor
name: Tetrahydrobiopterin, vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members cover BH4, PLP and Moco synthesis plus the cofactor-dependent phenylalanine hydroxylation and sulfite oxidation they serve, whereas confusables centre on tyrosine catabolism or sulfur amino acid metabolism.

qualifier: dopamine release and cAMP-independent receptor signalling
name: Dopamine release and cAMP-independent dopamine receptor signalling
rationale: Members concern dopaminergic transmission, dopamine secretion and PLC/beta-arrestin dopamine receptor signalling, whereas confusables carry adenylate cyclase-coupled dopamine receptors or drug-response behaviours.

qualifier: Na+/K+ pump and potassium channels
name: Na+/K+ pump and potassium-channel control of membrane potential
rationale: Members span Na+/K+ homeostasis by P-type ATPases (glycoside-sensitive) and Ca2+-activated/TRESK K+ channels setting resting potential and action potentials, while confusables lack either the pump or the excitability side.
